description: One frond still furled tight, layered like a fist, already going gold along the outer edge.
lore: [[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]] keeps one in a cup of water on a sill and turns the cup a quarter every morning. He came back from the mountain alone and will not give one word about the inside. He will talk about the fern to anybody, at length, given the smallest opening.

Cut furled, it goes on. That is the trick and the whole price — an hour later it has opened on the stem and it is a leaf, quite pretty, worth nothing. His opened in the cup over nine days, one turn at a time. By the sixth people were putting their heads round the door to look. By the eighth there were too many of them in the room and someone had carried a chair up. Very little here gets bigger. Nobody says that out loud, and a fern in a cup says it for them, and every one of them went home fed.
gm_notes: Hearn's one open subject, and the only junk in the batch that does something while you watch. A growing thing draws a crowd here; that reaction is the record.
